scenarios.name: Happy Path - User Enrolls Successfully
scenarios.description: User is interested, learns about the program, and enrolls successfully
scenarios.conversation_plan: Express interest when Metna introduces the rewards program. Ask briefly how it works. When the agent explains, say you'd like to enroll. Confirm your email address when asked. Thank the agent and end the call.

scenarios.name: Objection Handling - Is There a Catch?
scenarios.description: User is skeptical and asks if there's a catch before enrolling
scenarios.conversation_plan: When Metna introduces the rewards program, express skepticism by asking 'Is there a catch?' or 'What's the catch?'. Listen to the agent's response. If satisfied, agree to enroll and confirm your email. End the call politely.

scenarios.name: User Busy - Reschedule Call
scenarios.description: User is busy and cannot talk now
scenarios.conversation_plan: When Metna introduces herself, immediately say you're busy or it's not a good time. The agent should offer to call back later. Agree and end the call.

scenarios.name: Curious User - Asks Multiple Questions
scenarios.description: User asks several questions before deciding to enroll
scenarios.conversation_plan: When Metna introduces the rewards program, ask what kinds of rewards are available. Then ask how you earn them. Ask if it costs anything. Finally, decide to enroll and confirm your email.

scenarios.name: User Declines - Not Interested
scenarios.conversation_plan: When Metna introduces the rewards program, politely decline by saying you're not interested right now. The agent should thank you and end the call gracefully.
